title: spectra.config.json
description: Project settings for Spectra, read from the project root (or --config).

budgets.description: Upper limits. A run over any of them exits with code 2. Metrics a recording did not measure are skipped, never failed.

signIn.description: How Spectra signs in to your app before profiling it. Only the non-secret parts: the password, the authenticator secret, header values, cookies and storage entries come from the environment (SPECTRA_LOGIN_PASSWORD, SPECTRA_LOGIN_TOTP_SECRET, SPECTRA_LOGIN_HEADER, SPECTRA_LOGIN_COOKIES, SPECTRA_LOGIN_STORAGE).

method.description: form: a login form; link: a URL that signs in by itself; http: the browser's login prompt; token: a header, cookies or localStorage entries; manual: you sign in in the Chrome window

url.description: The login page, or the sign-in link. {url} in it becomes the page to return to

startSelector.description: CSS selector for a control to click first, such as a button that opens the login, when Spectra can't find it

usernameSelector.description: CSS selector for the username field, when Spectra can't find it

passwordSelector.description: CSS selector for the password field, when Spectra can't find it

submitSelector.description: CSS selector for the submit button, when Spectra can't find it

codeSelector.description: CSS selector for the one-time code field, when Spectra can't find it

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for a manual sign-in (default 300)
